styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: warm nordic home-storage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm cream wall background #F5EFE6, charcoal text #2D2A26, natural oak wood tone #D9B98C and one terracotta-orange accent #E2622B, with muted blue-grey #5B6478 kept as the secondary tone for thin-line icons and small labels; warm neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent soft-matte wall and panel backgrounds; soft diffused warm daylight from front-left with gentle contact shadows; consistent rounded-rectangle labels and thin two-tone line icons in #5B6478 and #E2622B; product shown as a wall-mounted slotted storage board with clean circular holes, stable scale, centered composition; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 由 10 片详情页长图切片（_sources/洞洞置物架/panels）提炼。已剥离：店铺水印与「加入会员」二维码贴片（源片10左下角）、全部源文案改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽位由使用方填写。备注1：源文件夹名为「家装家具家用品」，但以图为准，主产品为木质洞洞板墙面置物架（壁挂收纳架），归 家居日用/收纳整理，与源夹名不符。备注2：源片3收纳前后、源片4承重、源片5用途卡、源片6板材区域的实拍照片在源图中为灰色/纯色块（照片缺失），对应分镜按通用视觉语法重建，未照抄源图。备注3：承重数值与板材厚度等具体参数一律以 {callout} 槽位在生成时填写，未硬编码源产品规格。原五色调色板收敛为四色，蓝灰 #5B6478 保留为 iconSystem/typography 次要用色。
